messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered in #eng-oncall · latency.p99 > 1.2s for 5m · route=/v1/generate · model=redwood-large · region=us-west-2 · <https://ops.example/alerts/PDINC1234|view alert>
ashley: acked. I'm oncall, looking at dashboards now.
sam: which pool/variant is affected? customer-facing endpoints?
incident-bot: alert details: p95=0.46s p99=1.45s error_rate=0.3% tail_count=120 · affected nodes: gpu-pool-usw2-a,b,c · PDINC1234
dave: kv-cache evictions spiking on those nodes, sidecar CPU ~90% on pool instances. autoscaler logs show a few suppressed scale decisions.
maria: support seeing slow interactive UI reports since ~12:10, a few customers calling but no 5xx spike yet. tagging product for customer-impact triage.
ashley: running quick mitigation: scaling pool now -> `infra-cli scale-gpu-pool --pool redwood-large-usw2 --add 4`
dave: as fallback can we route a percent to redwood-medium variant while we stabilize? quick router command: `routerctl set-weight --route /v1/generate --model redwood-medium --weight 30`
sam: prefer canary 10% in us-east first? but us-west is hot, maybe split 10% us-west -> redwood-medium then increase.
ashley: starting canary 10% in us-west now, warming KV cache with a job: `jobs/warm-kv --pool redwood-large-usw2 --prefixes top100`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDINC1234 · acknowledged by ashley at 1799000130 · next escalation in 10m if not resolved
dave: checked autoscaler: scale suppressed because nodes marked `drain_in_progress` during rolling maintenance. opening infra ticket, overriding drain for that pool. `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=gpu-pool-usw2`
maria: adding customer-impact note: CUST-342 and CUST-188 reported sluggishness. CS updated with ETA 15-30m.
ashley: canary ramp to 35% on us-west -> redwood-medium. initial metrics: redwood-medium p99 ~0.8s. overall p99 trending down to ~0.95s.
sam: I'll take primary for the next 30m and monitor. ashley handing off now. please update PD notes with mitigations.
incident-bot: Alert cleared: latency.p99 back under threshold, resolved at 1799000890. PagerDuty PDINC1234 marked resolved.
dave: follow-up: investigate why autoscaler suppressed during drain and consider fallback routing policy to auto-promote medium variant on tail-latency SLO burn.
maria: creating a short post-incident note for CS + product. thanks all. :thumbsup:
